name: 2021 Games Event 6

origin.summary: An event from the 2021 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: Five rounds of a short run and a single heavy clean.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2021/6 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; clean load increases each round: 245-265-285-305-315 lb (men), 165-175-185-195-205 lb (women)
